name: EnterpriseConnectivityQuoteBuilder
tagline: Price multi-site connectivity deals with live margins and built-in approvals.
description: A complete B2B telecom quoting app in one Power Apps code component: multi-site quotes with access type, bandwidth, term, CPE and on/near/off-net pricing from a configurable price book, live MRC, NRC, TCV and margin, delegated-authority approvals, term comparison, a pipeline board and a price book view – for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Configurable price book (base + per Mbps, install, max bandwidth)
Near-net / off-net surcharges and term discounts
Live MRC, NRC, TCV, discount and margin per site and quote
Manager / director approval rules and margin floor
Status workflow with reasons, expiry and re-dating
Bulk status, owner and validity with Undo
controlType: standard (2 controls: EnterpriseConnectivityQuoteBuilder data-set + EnterpriseConnectivityQuoteBuilderPortal field control, shared src/app)
